name: Hand of Healing
description: As a Magic action, you can expend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature and restore a number of Hit Points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier. When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of the Unarmed Strikes with a use of this feature.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
